scope: Validated native root-slot hints for repeated indexed reads; no raw Value pointers or additional collection owners.
admission: Whole-function SSA locals with multiple static indexed reads or an indexed read in a backward-edge interval. Single-read nonloop locals and separately compiled loops keep the ordinary helper.
safety: Every hit checks slot bounds, matching handle and a live current value. Reallocation, mutation, nested calls, root release and slot reuse cannot expose a stale cached value.
deterministic_cost: 128 repeated reads require one authoritative handle HashMap lookup instead of 128.
probe_scope: Seven rotating rounds,100000 reads per case. Optimized standalone Rust probe links a debug Kujo library. Generic/warm/forced-cold compare helpers from the same candidate before compiler admission refinement; helper code unchanged. Concurrent production work and loaded host: diagnostic only, not end-to-end release or competitive acceptance.
